digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and create dispatch
propositions: under dc lucene index lag, a crashed create produces a keyless-pending binding entry that recover_pending unbinds on a single negative search, leaving no gate to prevent create_one from issuing a duplicate jira issue

the duplicate-prevention gate must be at the create site (dispatch_one.create_one), not only at recovery (recover_pending), because get_jira_key returns None for keyless-pending entries and the pending state itself is invisible to the create dedup logic

recover_pending's keyless branch must record search misses and defer unbinding until both search_miss_count >= 3 AND entry age exceeds a grace period (default 3600s), leaving the binding pending to enable the create gate

create_one must defer (not drop) create attempts when a keyless-pending binding exists for that local_id and is younger than the grace window, by consulting a new is_keyless_pending_within_grace accessor
the fix applies to both Cloud and DC vendors since eventual consistency affects both, with a narrower latency window on Cloud
recover_pending must not count still-pending entries as resolved in its return count
